local_network.status: This computer isn’t on a Wi-Fi or LAN network.
local_network.how:
Your phone talks to this computer directly over your local network, like two devices at home.

When
Your phone and this computer are on the same Wi-Fi or LAN, such as a home or office network.
Setup
Nothing to install. The first time on a network, AutoByteus asks for your OK.
Safety
The connection has no extra protection, so others on the same network could see it. Fine at home and in your office. On public Wi-Fi (café, hotel, airport) use Tailscale instead. Works only while the phone is on this network.

tailscale.note: Still not found. Tailscale isn’t on, on this computer.
tailscale.how:
Tailscale builds a private, encrypted connection between your phone and this computer, wherever they are.

When
You want to use your phone away from home, on mobile data or any Wi-Fi.
Setup
Install Tailscale (free) on this computer and on your phone. Get Tailscale.
Sign in to the same account on both, and keep it on.
Safety
The connection is encrypted between your phone and this computer, and only devices signed in to your Tailscale account can reach it.

vpn.status: No VPN found on this computer. Connect it, then Check again.
vpn.how:
Your VPN puts your phone and this computer in the same private network.

When
You already use your own VPN that connects your phone and this computer.
Setup
Connect both to the VPN. AutoByteus finds it by itself.
Safety
As protected as your VPN: the connection is encrypted between your devices.

company_address.how:
Your phone reaches the node at the address your company set up, through the company network or its VPN.

When
The node runs on a company server and your IT gave it an address, such as autobyteus.company.com.
Setup
Your IT sets the address once on the node. On your phone, turn on the company VPN if your company uses one.
Safety
Protected by your company’s network: usually a secure (https) address reachable only inside the company or through its VPN.
